verifiedOwnerFacts: BookStore(metadataFileURL:...,legacyMetadataDefaults:nil) uses the existing real metadata/chapter owner at fixture-only files; new ReadingBook ID is a fresh UUID and is off-shelf. saveReadingBook queues immediate metadata and queuedWritesLanded awaits real writer, not a settle sleep.

ChapterFetchManager.fetchChapter validates real cache before sourceResolver; cold consumer can demonstrate real public offline path by zero source-resolution count, stable content/cache fingerprints and unavailable producer listener.
JSONFileReadingPositionStore.saveChecked with no injected writeData produces atomicWriteCompleted receipt, loadChecked produces existingFileRead receipt/hash from owned disk files.

Global chapter cache cleanup is existing repository clearAllChapterCacheAwait(UUID), removing only that UUID subtree through the real writer. It is not a claim that deleting any asserted UUID is safe; consumer must validate ownership first.

xctest.sh default action test remains the old path; finite whitelist test-without-building can reuse the already-built installation, but matching real container before/after each host must still be measured. Different ProcessInfo PIDs plus observed actual producer process exit are needed.

Planned controller commits producer.json only after original xcresult summary+exact qualified testcase pass; source/run/nonce/container binding and exclusive fresh descriptors reject old receipts. No UIKit/device/full-source acceptance follows.
